title: External stock balance projection
description: Read-only stock balance whitelist without internal ledger, evidence, audit, or MISA references. Scope is finished goods only (OD-C24-01B, owner decision 05-09-2026): raw-material, packaging and work-in-progress balances are never projected, and their absence is deliberate rather than 'no stock'. The three hold quantities are DISJOINT buckets — see available_quantity for the invariant. This projection is for display and reconciliation; POST /v1/availability/check remains the sole authority for whether an order line may be committed.

item_type.description: Narrowed to FINISHED_GOOD in v1 so the finished-goods-only boundary is structural, not merely enforced in provider code (OD-C24-01B). Widening the scope requires a successor contract.

material_id.description: Reserved for a future non-finished-goods scope; NEVER emitted while item_type is restricted to FINISHED_GOOD.

on_hand_quantity.description: Total physically held at this balance row: available + reserved + quality_hold + recall_hold + sale_lock.

available_quantity.description: INVARIANT (OD-C24-01): on_hand_quantity = available_quantity + reserved_quantity + quality_hold_quantity + recall_hold_quantity + sale_lock_quantity, holding at every row and at every aggregation. The three hold buckets are a PARTITION, so consumers may add and subtract them freely without double counting.

quality_hold_quantity.description: Quantity blocked by a QC/quarantine hold. Lowest bucket priority: a row also under recall or sale lock is reported under that higher bucket instead, so a single row never contributes to two buckets.

recall_hold_quantity.description: Quantity blocked by an active recall. HIGHEST bucket priority (recall > sale lock > quality hold), so a row under several restrictions at once is reported here and its other reasons are not separately visible.

sale_lock_quantity.description: Quantity blocked by an active sale lock. Middle bucket priority: outranks a quality hold on the same row, and is itself outranked by a recall.
